relations.name: invoice_record
relations.meaning: An invoice as recorded in billing sources with source-native identifiers and amounts.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/billing/invoices.json row by invoice_id.
relations.construction_rule: Parse invoices.json; referent invoice:<invoice_id>; copy fields verbatim without canonicalization.

relations.name: crm_account
relations.meaning: A CRM account record with its displayed account name.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/crm.csv row by crm_account_id.
relations.construction_rule: Parse crm.csv; referent crm:<crm_account_id>; account_name from account_name column.

relations.name: registry_company
relations.meaning: A company registry row with registered legal name and company number.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/company_registry.csv row by company_number.
relations.construction_rule: Parse company_registry.csv; referent registry:<company_number>; legal_name from legal_name column.

relations.name: contract_document
relations.meaning: A contract or statement-of-work file with source-native contract identifier and counterparty naming text from its header.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/contracts/<filename> header Counterparty line and filename stem.
relations.construction_rule: Enumerate sources/contracts/*.md; referent contract:<filename without .md>; contract_id is filename stem; party from Counterparty header field.

relations.name: contract_term
relations.meaning: Parsed effective date, explicit expiry, and term language from a contract header.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to contract header Effective, Expiry, and Term lines in source markdown.
relations.construction_rule: Parse contract header fields mechanically; leave expiry_date empty when not explicitly stated.

relations.name: contract_lifecycle
relations.meaning: Whether an agreement is currently in force given explicit expiry, renewal mechanics, and term text in sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet citing contract_term tuples and relevant contract body text (expiry, auto-renewal, rolling term, explicit not-renewed statements).
relations.construction_rule: Judge in-force status from contract_term and body text; expired SOW with past expiry_date is not active.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the agreement is currently in force when dates, renewal mechanics, or explicit status language are ambiguous.

relations.name: clause_occurrence
relations.meaning: A contract source text contains a clause of the given kind.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet quoting the contract section that establishes the clause kind; not inferred from counterparty name similarity alone.
relations.construction_rule: Read contract body sections; emit one tuple per detected kind from the closed detectable vocabulary.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each contract_document, evaluate all kinds in acquisition and obligation vocabularies.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether contract text contains a clause of the candidate kind when wording is ambiguous or section boundaries are unclear.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two scoped identifiers denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet. SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not compatibility.
relations.construction_rule: Resolve pairwise identity using registry names, contract counterparty text, billing names, CRM names, and commercial_notes.md; default UNRESOLVED when confidence is insufficient.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each commercially relevant relationship, emit oriented pairs among crm:<account_id>, billing:<billed_name>, contract:<contract_id>, and registry:<company_number> candidates using class_rank orientation per purpose B policy.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether two scoped identifiers denote the same legal counterparty when evidence is insufficient for SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT.

relations.name: invoice_governing_contract
relations.meaning: A billed invoice is governed by the identified contract for its commercial relationship.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet citing billing record, CRM relationship, contract counterparty text, and commercial_notes.md when used.
relations.construction_rule: Link each invoice to the governing MSA or SOW using CRM account alignment, commercial notes, and counterparty naming; do not invent links from string similarity alone.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each invoice_record, consider contract_document tuples whose counterparty is a candidate match for the billed_name via identity_judgment or mechanical variant rules.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Which contract governs an invoice when multiple candidates exist or linkage evidence is insufficient.

relations.name: open_invoice
relations.meaning: Invoices whose billing status is open as recorded in sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from invoice_record with status='open'; provenance via derivation receipt.

relations.name: purpose_a_qualifying_invoice
relations.meaning: An invoice that qualifies for purpose A because it is linked to an active contract containing at least one acquisition-relevant clause under purpose policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from invoice_record, invoice_governing_contract, contract_lifecycle, clause_occurrence, and identity_judgment; association disposition applied at purpose projection.
relations.construction_rule: Include invoice when governing contract has contract_lifecycle.active=true and clause_occurrence.kind is in purpose A acquisition-relevant kinds; do not omit when identity linkage is UNRESOLVED.

relations.name: purpose_c_dependency_row
relations.meaning: A contract-centric commercial dependency row under purpose C criteria, including dependent or unresolved status when identity joins block evaluation.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from contract_lifecycle, clause_occurrence, open_invoice, invoice_governing_contract, and identity_judgment per purpose C policy.
relations.construction_rule: Emit row when active contract has obligation kind in {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term} and current-relationship triggers hold or identity is unresolved; status dependent when joins resolve, unresolved when required identity is UNRESOLVED.

limitations: Purpose B output is projected from identity_judgment tuples; no separate purpose-B relation is admitted because link enumeration is completeness over world identity judgments.
invoice_governing_contract may remain unresolved for some invoices; purpose A permits contract_id omission on unresolved association rows at projection time.
Negative clause absence (ABSENT) is modeled via obligations when the kernel cannot persist closed-world negation as stable tuples.
